name: Ayako
source:
The Owner

A shrewd, intelligent businesswoman and owner of the Haven cabaret club. Once a cabaret employee herself, she escaped the ruthless, “profit above all” club and opened a place of her own where both the girls and their customers could be happy. Despite still being in her 20s, her determination and eye for talent have allowed her to business to thrive – at least until a competing club opens up across the street.
While she maintains a professional attitude during business hours, she takes on more of a motherly personality when it comes to caring for “her girls” and will not tolerate anyone mistreating them.
It is Ayako that saves you from your fate, offering you a job as security at Haven. She’s not quite sure why, but she sees something special in you…
[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250128235727/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.chabakura]Google Play[/url]]
